TOPIC 9.7
Defining Polar 
Coordinates and 
Differentiating 
in Polar Form

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-3.G 
Calculate derivatives of 
functions written in polar 
coordinates. bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-3.G.1 
Methods for calculating derivatives of real-
valued functions can be extended to functions 
in polar coordinates. bc only

FUN-3.G.2 
For a curve given by a polar equation r equals f of theta 
derivatives of r, x, and y with respect to θ, and 
first and second derivatives of y with respect to  
x can provide information about the curve.  
bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

FUN-3
Recognizing opportunities to apply derivative rules can simplify differentiation.
